Cast: A is NEN, armilla blau fosc amb un triangle clar al davant; B is HOME, samarreta ocre amb dues ratlles blanques al davant.
Photoreal. Same boy on left and adult man on right from plan in simple kitchen/dining area, one dining table, cabinets softly blurred behind. Boy holds one clear milk pitcher upright on near left edge. Two distinctive ceramic drinking mugs: one BLUE with a single rounded C handle; one plain RUST RED with ONE D-shaped handle, only on its right side. P1 only the blue mug is on the table, no red mug yet, man points to the vacant placemat. P2 the man has just set one red mug down on the right placemat, his empty hands are retracting, SINGLE handle clearly facing right with no other marks or handles, blue still there. P3 boy pours a short stream of white milk from pitcher directly into red mug, blue has already been filled. P4 both seated at same spots, left boy drinks from blue mug and right man sips from red mug, the same clear pitcher almost empty on table. Both mugs always same size and form, one well-formed handle each (red same handle as blue), no more than one of each. Two actors only, four equal frames, no cups in background.
